title: NexKoth
description: The NexKoth plugin is a modern and user-friendly KOTH (King of the Hill) system for Minecraft servers
body:
🔥 NexKoth – Features
****⚙️ Core System****

Full support for Minecraft 1.21 – 1.21.11
Lightweight and optimized performance
Easy-to-use command system
Create, edit, and delete KOTH arenas in-game
Multi-arena support
Auto-start scheduling & manual control
WorldEdit or built-in region selection



****🏆 KOTH Gameplay****

Real-time capture system with progress tracking
Configurable capture timers
Player vs Player or team-based capture modes
Live broadcast messages (start, capture, win)
Action bar & title notifications
Anti-camping and fair capture mechanics



****🎁 Advanced Reward System****

Fully customizable rewards:
Commands
Items
Economy (Vault support)
Permissions
Multiple reward tiers
Randomized rewards option
Set rewards easily via GUI
Instant or delayed reward distribution



****🧩 Custom GUI System (Main Feature)****

Fully interactive GUI-based control system
Admin GUI panel for:
Creating/editing KOTHs
Managing rewards
Starting/stopping events
Drag-and-click style configuration
Support for custom menus (YAML-based GUI configs)
Compatible with external menu plugins



****📊 Scoreboard & UI****

Dynamic and customizable scoreboard
Displays:
Active KOTH
Capture progress
Time remaining
PlaceholderAPI support
Per-player scoreboard toggle
Action bar & boss bar support



****🔧 Configuration & Customization****

Fully customizable config.yml
Editable messages with color & hex support
Custom sounds and effects
Adjustable timers, regions, and capture rules
Reload command (no restart needed)
Multi-language support ready



****🔌 Integrations****

Vault (economy support)
PlaceholderAPI
Works with most permission plugins
Compatible with popular server software (Paper/Spigot)



****🛡️ Advanced Features****

Anti-cheat friendly detection system
Cooldown system for rejoining KOTH
Optional PvP-only zones
Region protection during events
Custom join/leave rules
Offline reward handling



****📦 Developer & Admin Friendly****

Clean and well-structured configs
Extensive permission system
Developer API (optional expansion support)
Easy setup for beginners, powerful tools for advanced users



****🎯 Why NexKoth?****

Simple like AxKoth plugin, but far more powerful
Built for modern servers with advanced customization
Focused on GUI-based management & flexibility
Perfect for both small and large servers
